plan.archetype: Early area damage into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring reliable area damage to eliminate followers, established poison scaling, dexterity-enhanced block, and strong potions. Upgrade key damage and defensive cards.
plan.summary: The starter deck lacks boss damage and scaling. Add efficient attacks and area damage first, then poison and dexterity. Keep additions selective; fight elites with adequate health and potions.

plan.archetype: Group poison with efficient attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Preserve health, strengthen poison and group damage, and carry defensive potions. Use Haze to weaken all enemies while focusing down followers.
plan.summary: Keep the two-campfire route. Add efficient damage, poison scaling, and stronger defense selectively. Heal at the next campfire; upgrade key cards when health permits. Avoid further elites before Kin.

plan.archetype: Scaling poison with dexterity defense and lasting debuffs
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with candle charges, upgraded Malaise, reliable poison scaling, and multihit mitigation. Preserve Powdered Demise; respect the three-card limit.
plan.summary: Follow four campfires without elites. Add poison scaling and dexterity rather than marginal attacks. Prioritize Malaise and Flask upgrades. Heal when threatened; recharge the candle when health permits, ensuring energy for the boss.

plan.archetype: Scaling poison backed by dexterity and lasting mitigation
plan.bossPrep: Bring stronger poison, upgraded Malaise and Footwork, healthy HP, and active candle charges. Respect the three-card limit; prioritize efficient poison and multihit mitigation.
plan.summary: Boss simulations expose insufficient damage. Upgrade Flask now, heal next fire, and prioritize poison scaling over additional generic defense. Keep the no-elite route; recharge the candle before it leaves mandatory fights unsupported.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity and lasting strength reduction
plan.bossPrep: Heal to 27; establish Footwork, apply substantial Malaise early, build Flask poison, use poison potion, reserve Wail for multihits. Respect actual three-card limits.
plan.summary: Heal now; no acquisition opportunities remain before the boss. Sustain poison with lasting mitigation rather than small attacks. If victorious, spend saved gold on scaling, useful potions, and removals; avoid elites until recovery.
